Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِيْ فِيْهِ إِلَى مَرْضَاتِكَ دَلِيْلًا
Translation: O Allah, make for me in it a guide to Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيْهِ عَلَيَّ سَبِيلًا
Translation: And do not make a way for Satan over me in it
And make Paradise for me a home and resting place
O Fulfiller of the needs of those who seek
